short: Class balancing; generate only if it beats baselines
why: Rare types are very scarce; simple fixes must be beaten first
decision: Task=class balancing. Generate rare-class cells with a conditional model; recommend synthetic only if real+synthetic macro-F1 (and rare-class F1) beats best of real_only/class-weighted/oversample with paired bootstrap CI excluding 0; otherwise recommend the baseline. Reference: real test split.
evidence: imbalance ratio 76.27; Megakaryocytes 11 train, Dendritic 28 train (profile.json)
alternatives_rejected: decline outright: rejected, imbalance is extreme so worth testing

why: Cells differ in depth, counts are skewed, genes outnumber cells
evidence: row_sum max/min 15.9; skewness 13.9; samples_per_feature 0.159; log1p top2000 variance share 0.689 (profile.json)
alternatives_rejected: pca: loses gene interpretability; raw counts: model learns depth

why: Small data and tiny rare classes suit a VAE
decision: conditional VAE, mlp backbone, no second family
alternatives_rejected: ddpm/wgan: need >=5-10k samples; flow: no likelihood needed

why: Small data trains fast; leaves budget for one retry
decision: latent_dim 16, hidden [512,256], beta 1, warmup 10, lr 1e-3, bs 64, 150 epochs, max 4 min
evidence: smoke test ran OK; budget 10 min

why: All latent dimensions used, loss flattened

short: Generate 200 cells each for two rarest types
why: Balancing target types: megakaryocytes and dendritic cells
decision: sample.py --class-counts Mega 200, DC 200, prior latent, tag prior
evidence: 400 samples; label consistency 0.0725 vs real 0.953 (metrics_prior.json); macro-F1 diff CIs all include 0

why: Prior samples were rarely recognised as the intended type
decision: Iteration 1: resample with --latent-source posterior --temperature 1.5, tag post
evidence: per-class label consistency DC 0.14, Mega 0.005 (metrics_prior.json); recall 0.31
alternatives_rejected: retrain with lower beta: costs budget, posterior sampling is the documented fix

why: Synthetic cells must beat simple fixes to be worth using
decision: Evaluated fidelity, memorization, augment utility on post samples
evidence: label consistency 0.905 (ref 0.953); recall 0.0; nearest-real-is-train 0.9975 (exp 0.5); macro-F1 real+syn 0.9033 vs real_only 0.9079, CI [-0.03,0.021]; vs class-weighted [-0.006,0.013]; test n: DC 9, Mega 4 (metrics_post.json)

short: Do not use synthetic cells; use class weights
why: No measurable gain over simple methods; test counts tiny
decision: Do not use (use class weighting or real_only). Synthetic cells (samples_post.npz) are smoothed variants of 11 and 28 real cells, no gain; stop iterating.
evidence: all macro-F1 diff CIs include 0 (metrics_post.json); Mega F1 0.667 in every arm; model space log-normalized standardized 2000 HVG
alternatives_rejected: more iterations: unlikely to change verdict given 4 test Mega cells
